title: Feature envelopes
description: R3B versioned feature envelopes (14 §R3B): the closed kind list, a version, and each kind's registration in protocol/feature_registry.json. Field vocabularies are frozen in the milestone that first exercises each kind (R5, R7, R8, or when pulled); until then an envelope carries no feature fields at all, so nothing can ship an unstable anonymous map (14 §R3B).

FeatureKind.description: One R3B feature kind (14 §R3B). Exactly the kinds in protocol/feature_registry.json, which gives each one's spec section and freeze milestone; unknown kinds are invalid. A reference to a feature definition is a DefinitionRef whose kind is one of these values (05 §4).

FeatureEnvelope.description: Kind and schema version of one feature value (14 §R3B). The kind's freeze milestone adds its versioned fields here, as a oneOf branch per kind; before that, any other property is invalid.

FeatureRegistryEntry.description: One entry of protocol/feature_registry.json: a kind, the spec section that defines it, and the milestone that freezes its fields (14 §R3B).
